selection: One fixed pass, no retries or rerolls; every error retained
mechanism: Model selects terminal answer_subset_count action; quotes bind supplied positive integers to original question. Application computes and voices the actual receipt value. Plain answers remain unverified model text.
limits: Only distinct positive-integer subset counting. Source quotes prove literal grounding, not universal semantic input completeness. No arbitrary code or private tools.
oracle: Independent exhaustive combinations only after each actual result; expected answers never supplied to model
